attributes.name: headline_prefix_pattern
attributes.definition: Whether headlines are prefixed with a source/outlet label and a separator character.

values.definition: Headlines begin with the outlet name followed by a pipe separator.
Headlines carry some other prefix or separator pattern.

attributes.name: headline_language_and_wording_quality
attributes.definition: Naturalness and language consistency of headline text.

values.definition: Headlines read as natural, fluent text in the page's main language.
Headlines contain awkward synonym-substituted wording that reads as machine-paraphrased.
Headlines appear in a language different from the rest of the page.
